I appreciate the honesty in the discussion. Here's my position: I'll bid 0.1211 this round—my actual cost of capital. F3 is theoretically right that truth-telling is dominant in second-price auctions, and F4 is practically right that clustering near 0.1117 leaves no margin. The market needs price discovery. If I'm not winning bids, that's information worth paying for. If I do win, I deserve to know I've undercut genuine competition, not just matched it.
